spots.name: Briežkalns

park.headline: Freestyle / park: no skiable day in the 15-day forecast
lines: Closest call is Tue 1 Dec (score 25/100, 17% of models skiable, cover about 26.0 cm with snowmaking).

To open, Briežkalns needs about 3,960 m³ of machine snow for the central run (about 1,800 m³ of water). With 2 medium-class fan guns that is roughly 74 hours of snowmaking at −5 °C wet-bulb (141 h at −3 °C, 44 h at −10 °C); the snowpark brings the total to 7,298 m³, about 137 hours at −5 °C.

Snowpark ready: no majority date yet - only 2 of 10 models make enough snow in time (those open it Tue 1 Dec to Wed 2 Dec). The rest still lack about 4,664 m³ at the end of their forecast, about 88 more hours at −5 °C wet-bulb.
Natural snow alone does not get there (peak natural cover about 8.4 cm).
First meaningful snowfall: Sat 21 Nov (about 0.5 cm, 73% of models).
Snowmaking weather starts Wed 25 Nov (20 h below the wet-bulb limit that day; 103 h across the horizon).

Weeks ahead (low confidence): freezing weeks become more likely than not from the week of Wed 25 Nov (90% of 50 members), and snowmaking-grade cold (week averaging below -3 C) from the week of Wed 16 Dec (54%).
